text.en:
Act Numbered Thirty-four hundred and fifty-three is hereby repealed and subsection (g) of Act
Numbered Thirty-four hundred and twenty-seven is restored as it was before its amendment by said Act
Numbered Thirty-four hundred and fifty-three: Provided, That the municipality of Dapitan, Province of
Zamboanga, shall refund all preliminary expenses properly and legally incurred so far by the municipality of
Dipolog or its inhabitants, by voluntary contributions, for the construction of the hospital referred to in Act
Numbered Thirty-four hundred and fifty-three.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 8, 1929.
